advisoryFindings.title: Add explicit unitId load assertion
advisoryFindings.improvement: R2 would be stronger with a direct store-level assertion that lookup occurs by stable unitId and then rejects reuse when the stored full identity differs from the planned full identity.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: Current R2 and R4 tests cover the core identity separation and stale decision behavior, so this is an extra precision check rather than missing executable coverage.

advisoryFindings.title: Cover child fallback failure variants
advisoryFindings.improvement: R8 coverage could add parser_failure and schema_failure to the positive retryable threshold examples, not only provider_failure and timeout.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: R10 separately classifies all retryable WorkUnit tooling failures, and R8 already validates the split behavior with retryable failures, so the current coverage is sufficient for implementation to proceed.
